# n8n Localization

> Community-maintained interface localization installer for existing self-hosted n8n installations. It does not contain or install n8n itself.

Repository: https://github.com/Melaszzzz/n8n-localization
License: MIT for this project's installer and translations
Platforms: macOS, Windows, Linux
Deployment: self-hosted n8n only; n8n Cloud is not supported
Current complete locale: zh-CN (Simplified Chinese)

Install:
npx --yes --package git+https://github.com/Melaszzzz/n8n-localization.git n8n-localize --locale zh-CN

List locales:
npx --yes --package git+https://github.com/Melaszzzz/n8n-localization.git n8n-localize --list-locales

Uninstall:
npx --yes --package git+https://github.com/Melaszzzz/n8n-localization.git n8n-localize --locale zh-CN --uninstall

Detailed machine-oriented instructions: AI_INSTALL.md
Human documentation: README.md and README.zh-CN.md
